differential.name: Chronic kidney disease, stage 4 (CKD)
differential.rationale: Creatinine 2.7 mg/dL, metabolic acidosis (CO₂ 20.8 mmol/L), hypertension and prediabetes explain progressive renal dysfunction.

differential.name: Acute kidney injury superimposed on CKD (e.g., NSAID‑induced analgesic nephropathy)
differential.rationale: Sudden rise in creatinine with known osteoarthritis and likely NSAID use can precipitate an AKI on chronic disease.

differential.name: Non‑small cell lung cancer progression/metastasis
differential.rationale: Known stage I NSCLC; cancer can cause anemia of chronic disease and may be advancing despite early stage.

differential.name: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (emphysema) exacerbation
differential.rationale: History of emphysema; exacerbations can worsen gas exchange and contribute to systemic hypoxia and renal hypoperfusion.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease secondary to CKD and cancer
differential.rationale: Low erythrocyte count with normocytic indices (MCV 40.5 fL) fits anemia of chronic disease in the setting of CKD and malignancy.
